title: TimedSerializer accepts timestamps from the future
body: Investigate whether a TimestampSigner token dated later than the verification clock is accepted when max_age is supplied. The report describes a historical compatibility problem: timestamps created by a newer release could be interpreted as far-future values by an older verifier, potentially accepting a message outside the intended validity window. Locate timestamp conversion and signature age checks. Exact clock-skew tolerance requires an independently agreed Oracle before changing behavior.
